suite: leaders across the seam (synthetic anchors, the lit set, the selection triple, P2)
expect_red: a node whose anchor is null, or lies off the scene, gets no leader and no stub

mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff leaders_follow_the_active_study_across_the_seam (2026-10-27). Reads a null anchor as a point inside the scene, so it gets a leader. (A stub at the dot itself would be clipped as off the scene, which is why the mutation lives here and not in the geometry.)
mutations.find: anchors[id] = a ? [fx + a[0], fy + a[1]] : null;
mutations.replace: anchors[id] = a ? [fx + a[0], fy + a[1]] : [fx + 10, fy + 10];
